why: No proof, disproof, or resolution of the general standard conjectures found; but several 2025 preprints prove special cases (e.g. Hodge standard conjecture for powers of abelian threefolds, arXiv:2510.21562; standard conjecture D results, arXiv:2508.13882), and it is unclear whether these count as genuine cases of the stated conjecture being settled versus routine incremental special-case literature that predates the snapshot in kind.
